messages:
anna.csm: Quick sync — Willow onboarding hit repeat 503s during yesterday's batch ingest, raising renewal concern. Noticed recurring window ~01:10-01:25 UTC. Any updates on root cause and action items? @devon.eng @mike.sre :eyes:
priya.support: Logs show ~14 503 responses from model-service to their ingest workers. Customer reported degraded qps + timeouts. I opened an incident and grabbed the earliest error snippets.
incident-bot: Incident INC-4312 created by priya.support at 2026-03-20T01:18:05Z
mike.sre: I'm seeing the same in infra metrics. Pattern: bursty parallel requests with long contexts (>32k tokens) causing sustained KV cache growth and memory pressure on the dedicated shard. Repro locally with script (ab -n 1000 -c 50) + long prefills.
devon.eng: Confirmed. Repro steps from my sandbox: run ingest script with sequence length ~35k, observe KV pinned entries, then mem reclaim fails -> 503. Quick patch in staging to clamp concurrent KV growth is ready (PR #2789). Canary rolling now.
devon.eng: Canary log excerpt: `2026-03-20T01:42:12Z WARN memcache: evicting 4 entries; 2026-03-20T01:46:01Z INFO http: 200 OK` After clamp, 503s ceased in canary for same workload.
anna.csm: Okay — who owns customer comms and mitigation ETA? Need to be explicit for account health notes.
priya.support: I'll own comms. Draft to Julia (Willow) says: "We're throttling concurrent ingest and applying a configuration change; full patch targeted tonight. We'll follow up with timeline + mitigation steps." ETA to send update: 30m.
mike.sre: I'll own short-term infra mitigation: add autoscaling threshold and a temporary throttle at the gateway for that org id. I'll add monitoring alert and watch for regressions. Estimated 1.5h to put rules in prod and validate.
devon.eng: I'll own the code fix and postmortem. Target merge for graceful KV eviction and safe concurrent clamp in 6h, deploy during low-traffic window at 02:30 UTC. Will add test vectors and perf numbers to INC-4312.
anna.csm: Action items summarized: 
- priya.support: send customer update + recommend reduced concurrency until patch.
- mike.sre: implement autoscale & gateway throttle, monitor.
- devon.eng: merge patch + deploy + write blameless postmortem.
Please add your updates to INC-4312 and tag when done.
priya.support: Added notes to INC-4312 and pinged Julia with the planned message. She acknowledged receipt and asked for ETA, which I provided.
mike.sre: Autoscale rule created and smoke tests pass. I'll post graphs in the incident thread and keep an eye on 01:10-01:30UTC window.
devon.eng: PR #2789 opened and linked in INC-4312. Running extended staging tests now (load 1k reqs/min with long context).
anna.csm: Thanks. Can we reconvene in 24h for a status update? If no regression, we'll mark the incident as mitigated and include the items in the weekly account health summary for Willow. :thumbsup:
devon.eng: Will post merge + perf numbers here when done.
priya.support: I'll update the customer after deploy and confirm reduced concurrency recommendations were followed.
anna.csm: Closing this thread after the 24h check unless new activity appears.
